items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for a second straight day.
items.why: Hamstring injuries from prior game; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Unlikely to play Week 5 in London vs JAX; week-to-week.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for backups like Will Shipley in backfield.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle injury. Friday’s practice looms large for Sunday night availability vs ATL.
items.implication: Potential OUT or GTD for SNF; Huntley likely starter if out.
items.opportunity: Boost to Ravens pass catchers or Huntley if Lamar sits.

items.text: Adam Levitan and Evan Silva: 'I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville' after Barkley/Bigsby injuries.
items.implication: Shipley primary workload vs JAX; strong fantasy opportunity.

items.text: Cowboys WR CeeDee Lamb dealing with quad bruise; extra few days should help.
Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 5; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Potential target bump for other BUF pass catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot).
items.implication: Likely OUT or doubtful vs DEN; look to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for other LAC WRs.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; strong volume and matchup.
items.why: Target hog, red zone, Titans defense struggles vs WRs.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload and matchup vs weak run D, plus Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Volume hard to ignore; defenses carved by RBs; WR injuries boost.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot injury (plantar fasciitis); coach says miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Extended absence; impacts PIT WR depth.
items.opportunity: Upgrades for other Steelers receivers like DK Metcalf.

items.text: Bucky Irving looked shot out of a cannon in TNF; RB16 rank was dismissive as he went off in Bucs win.
Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) for volume/matchups.
items.why: Target volume, red zone, coverage weaknesses.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) and Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17) due to tough matchups, thin roles, usage numbers; Addison injury wrinkle.
First Week 5 projections live; DET-ARZ shaping up as one of most popular DFS game stacks due to high total (54.5) and pricing.
items.opportunity: Elevated scoring environment for both offenses.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming.
items.implication: Sustain or regression candidates; trust process on overperformers.
